title: Credit Standard on Aggregate Operating Exposure — Operating Lines of Credit Commitment Limits
content:
Commitments on the Operating Lines of Credit are aggregated across the member's operating credit, and each line must also stay inside its own product's commitment band.

## Standard

**Aggregate limit.** The combined commitment of all the member's lines in applied, active, suspended or matured status, with the line being opened, increased or renewed counted at its requested commitment, may not exceed the largest commitment of the highest-ranked product among those lines. When any of those lines is a StartRight Operating Line, the combined cap is the StartRight Operating Line largest commitment regardless of the other products held, because the young, beginning and small farmer program limits the member's total operating exposure.

**Product band.** Each individual line must also stay between its own product's smallest commitment and largest commitment.

**Breach.** A request that would breach either limit is not registered at the amount asked; the member may resubmit at an amount within the limits.

**Release.** Seasonal Operating Loans repaid in full and closed release their commitment from the aggregate on their closed date.

## The combined commitment as a quantity

The combined commitment is the total of the commitments of the member's lines in applied, active, suspended or matured status other than the line being opened, increased or renewed, together with the commitment requested for that line. It may equal the cap; it may not exceed it. The two tests are separate: a request must pass both.

## Worked cases (hypothetical commitments)

| Lines held (status, commitment) | Request | Combined commitment | Applicable cap | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Revolving Operating Line (active, USD 4,000,000) | New Seasonal Operating Loan, USD 1,000,000 | USD 5,000,000 | Revolving Operating Line largest commitment, USD 5,000,000 (the higher-ranked of rank 4 and rank 3) | Within both limits |
| Revolving Operating Line (active, USD 4,000,000) | New Seasonal Operating Loan, USD 1,500,000 | USD 5,500,000 | USD 5,000,000 | Not registered at that amount |
| StartRight Operating Line (active, USD 100,000) | New Seasonal Operating Loan, USD 60,000 | USD 160,000 | StartRight Operating Line largest commitment, USD 150,000 | Not registered at that amount |
| Seasonal Operating Loan (closed after payoff, USD 800,000); Revolving Operating Line (active, USD 4,500,000) | Renewal of the Revolving Operating Line at USD 5,000,000 | USD 5,000,000 — the closed loan no longer counts | USD 5,000,000 | Within both limits |
